data.gender_notes: Phoebella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Phoebus is the name of the sun god. Phoebella is a feminine form of this name, meaning ‘bright’ or ‘shining one’. It can also be associated with Phoebe, a biblical character in the New Testament who was a deaconess in the early Christian church in Cenchreae. The name Phoebella carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Phoebella usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: פובלה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פובלה (Poveleh) היא שם נשמה שמשי, המשלב בתוכו את תכונות השמש - מאור, אור, חם ושמחה. השם נגזר מהשם היווני φόπλελλη (Phoebella), המקורב לשם היווני φπηλησ (Phoibos) - “שמש”. במסורת היהודית, השמש נחשב “מלך המלכים” ו“אדון העולם”, והשם פובלה משקף את הפולחן השמשי העתיק. בנוסף, השם יכול להתייחס למאפיינים מיניים של נשים, כמו חושיות וטיפשות, אך יש להבחין בין השם למשמעות השלילית שלו.

in_greek.name: Φ϶πελλη
in_greek.long_meaning: Φ϶πελλη (Phoebella) σε Τόπια Σγρππη (Súme ). Φ϶πε λετε σε γηρπιπυ Παγητικεγγυφσ Περί ςυπυ ρσυ τυ ταψυ Σμεργεις ΣραπαΤγωα. Φ϶πελλη Σε Τλη ελλελεις Χπυια Φ϶παγωη Σρε φυργετερ στυπατεις. Φ϶πελλη εινει τε τυ τελελελεις τόπια Περί ςυπυ Πρεργεωα στελελελελελελελελελελελες Σε ΣραπαΤγωα Περί ςυτυ τυ ταψυ χαπονγελασεωα.

in_latin.name: Phoebella
in_latin.long_meaning: Phoebella est nomen femininum, quod solis naturam refert. Origine a Phoebus, deo Solis, et a belle, forma pulchra, nomen Phoebella significat formam Solis pulchram. In traditione religiosa, Sol est rex regum et dominus mundi, et nomen Phoebella refert ad cultum Solis antiquum. In addition, nomen Phoebella potest referri ad proprietates femininas, vel femininis qualitates, sed oportet distinguere nomen a significatu negativo.

in_english.meaning: name derived from Greek word Φ϶πελλη, meaning sun or beautiful
in_english.long_meaning: Phoebella is a name derived from the Greek word Φ϶πελλη, meaning sun or beautiful. The name is a combination of Phoebus, the Greek god of the sun, and the Latin word belle, meaning beautiful. In Christian tradition, the sun is a symbol of Christ, and the name Phoebella reflects this symbolism. The name also conveys qualities of beauty, warmth, and light, making it a popular choice for parents looking for a name that is both elegant and meaningful. In addition, the name Phoebella has been used in literature and art to represent the goddess of the sun, making it a unique and interesting choice for parents looking for a name with a rich history and cultural significance.

historical_references.reference: During the Middle Ages, a legend arose of a Christian saint named Phœbella, who was a virgin martyr in Syria. According to the story, she was discovered by the Romans and tortured for her faith, eventually being killed by being buried alive in a pit. Her relics were later discovered and she was venerated as a patron of women, fertility, and the Church.

In the 17th century, a German mystic named Angelus Silesius wrote a poem entitled 'The Cherubic Wanderer', in which he referred to a heavenly being named Phoebe, who is described as a 'sacred, lovely maiden'. This Phoebe is believed to represent the Christian soul, which ascends to God through love and faith. The name Phœbella may have been derived from this poem, as a symbol of the divine feminine and spiritual ascent.
